reference.title: Neuf icônes d'inventaire
reference.prompt: Create a polished game art demonstration sheet: exactly nine distinct fantasy dungeon inventory item icons in a perfectly regular 3 by 3 grid, no words or lettering. Each icon fully separated with generous margins, equal scale and centered in its own invisible cell, on a uniform solid midnight navy background #101824, no card frames. Row 1: ruby health potion in round glass bottle, icy blue mana potion in triangular glass bottle, jade poison vial. Row 2: ancient bronze dungeon key with a skull bow, short iron sword with a worn leather grip, folded parchment dungeon map tied with red cord. Row 3: small oak treasure chest bound with brass, luminous violet crystal cluster, silver ring with an emerald. Cohesive handcrafted stylized fantasy RPG art, charming chunky silhouettes, hand-painted 3D appearance, readable at small sizes, controlled highlights upper left, exquisite material clarity, warm brass and teal accents. Three-quarter isometric object views; no environmental scene, no characters, no watermarks. These are illustrative item icon concepts.
